==Ingredients==
===Crust===
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

===Filling===
*2 cans (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 425 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]]
*½ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==
#Combine flour, butter, and milk. Cut together to make dough and set aside.
#Pour peaches in 9x13-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. Sprinkle sugar on top.
#Roll out crust and place on top of peaches.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350 °F or until top is browned lightly (approximately one hour).

== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Easy Peach Cobbler|Easy Peach Cobbler]]
* [[Cookbook:Sweet Peach Cobbler|Sweet Peach Cobbler]]
